verses.eng: and the rest of the angels of the Midst, every one of them according to his glory, will rule with me in the inheritances of the Light. And I shall rule over them all in the inheritances of the Light.

But this shall not take place till the consummation of the aeon. "All this then which I have said to you, will not take place at this time, but it will take place at the consummation of the aeon, that is at the ascension of the universe; that is at the dissolution of the universe and at the total ascension of the numbering of the perfect souls of the inheritances of the Light.

"Before the consummation, therefore, this which I have said to you, will not take place, but every one will be in his own region, into which he has been set from the beginning, until the numbering of the ingathering of the perfect souls is completed.

"The seven Voices and the five Trees and the three Amens and the Twin-saviours and the nine guards and the twelve saviours and those of the region of the Right and those of the region of the Midst, every one will abide in the region in which they have been set, until the numbering of the perfect souls of the inheritances of the Light shall be raised up all together.
"And also all the rulers who have repented, they also will abide in the region into which they have been set, until the numbering of the souls of the Light shall be raised up all together.

Of the ascension of the souls of the perfect. "[The souls] will all come, every one at the time when he will receive the mysteries; and all the rulers who have repented, will pass through and come into the region of the Midst. And those of the Midst will baptize them and give to them the spiritual unction and seal them with the

seals of their mysteries. And they will pass through those of all the regions of the Midst, and they will pass through the region of the Right and the interior of the region of the nine guards and the interior of the region of the Twin-saviours and the interior of the region of the three Amens and of the twelve saviours and the interior of the five Trees and of the seven Voices. Every one gives to them his seal of his mystery, and they pass into the interior of them all and go to the region of the inheritances of the Light; and every one bides in the region up to which he has received mysteries in the inheritances of the Light.

Of the rank of the souls of the perfect. "In a word, all the souls of men who shall receive the mysteries of the Light, will precede all the rulers who have repented, and they will precede all those of the region of the Midst and those of the whole region of the Right, and they will precede those of the whole region of the Treasury of the Light. In a word, they will precede all those of the region [of the Treasury], and they will precede all those of the regions of the first Commandment, and they will pass into the interior of them all and go into the Inheritance of the Light up to the region of their mystery; and every one abides in the region up to which he has received mysteries. And those of the region of the Midst and of the Right and those of the whole region of the Treasury, every one abides in the region of the order into which he has been set from the beginning on, until the universe shall be raised up. And every one of them accomplishes his economy to which he has been set, in respect of the ingathering of the souls who

have received the mysteries, in respect of this economy, so that they may seal all the souls who will receive the mysteries and who will pass through their interior towards the Inheritance of the Light.
"Now, therefore, Marayam, this is the word concerning which you do question me with precision and certainty. For the rest now then, who has ears to hear, let him hear."
"It came to pass then, when Jesus had finished speaking these words, that Marayam Magdalene started forward and said:

Marayam interprets the discourse from the scriptures. "My Adanay, my indweller of light has ears and I comprehend every word which you say. Now, therefore, my Adanay, on account of the word which you have spoken: 'All the souls of the race of men who shall receive the mysteries of the Light, will go into the Inheritance of the Light before all the rulers who will repent, and before those of the whole region of the Right and before the whole region of the Treasury of the Light,'--on account of this word, my Adanay, you have said to us aforetime: 'The first will be last and the last will be first,'--that is, the last' are the whole race of men which will enter into the Light-kingdom sooner than all those of the region of the Height, who are the first.' On this account, therefore, my Adanay, have you said to us: 'Who has ears to hear, let him hear,'--that is you desire to know whether we comprehend every word which you speak. This, therefore, is the word, my Adanay."
It came to pass then, when Marayam had finished saying these words, that the Saviour was greatly astonished at the definitions of the words which
she spoke, for she had become pure spirit utterly. Jesus answered again and said to her: Well said, spiritual and pure Marayam. This is the solution of the word."

It came to pass then again after all these words, that Jesus continued in the discourse and said to his disciples: "Hearken, that I may discourse with you concerning the glory of those of the Height, how they are, according to the manner in which I discoursed with you to this day.

Of the last Helper. "Now, therefore, if I lead you into the region of the last Helper, who surrounds the Treasury of the Light, and if I lead you into the region of that last Helper and you see the glory in which he is, then will the region of the Inheritance of the Light count for you only for the size of a city of the world, because of the greatness in which the last Helper is, and because of the great light in which he is.

That the regions beyond the Helpers are indescribable. "And thereafter I will discourse with you also concerning the glory of the Helper who is above the little Helper. But I shall not be able to discourse with you concerning the regions of those who are above all Helpers; for there exists no type in this world, to describe them, for there exists in this world no likeness which is like to them, that I may compare them therewith, nor greatness nor light which is like to them, not only in this world, but they also have no likeness with those of the Height of Righteousness from their region upwards. On this account, therefore, there exists in fact no manner of describing them in this world because of the great glory of those of the Height and because of the
great immeasurable greatness. On this account, therefore, there exists no manner to describe it in this world."

It came to pass then, when Jesus had finished speaking these words to his disciples, that Marayam Magdalene came forward and said to Jesus: "My Adanay, be not wroth with me if I question you, because I trouble repeatedly. Now, therefore, my Adanay, be not wroth with me if I question you concerning all with precision and certainty. For my brethren will herald it among the race of men, so that they may hear and repent and be saved from the violent judgments of the evil rulers and go to the Height and inherit the Light-kingdom; because, my Adanay, we are compassionate not only towards ourselves, but compassionate towards the whole race of men, so that they may be saved from all the violent judgments. Now, therefore, my Adanay, on this account we question concerning all with certainty; for my brethren herald it to the whole race of men, in order that they may escape the violent rulers of the darkness and be saved out of the hands of the violent receivers of the outer-most darkness."

It came to pass, when Jesus had heard Marayam say these words, that the Saviour answered in great compassion towards her and said to her: "Question concerning what you desire to question, and I will reveal it to you with precision and certainty and without similitude."

Marayam further questions Jesus. It came to pass then, when Marayam had heard the Saviour say these words, that she rejoiced with great joy and exulted exceedingly and said to Jesus: "My Adanay, by how much
greatness then is the second Helper greater than the first Helper? By how much distance is he distant from him, or rather how many times more does he shine than the latter?"

Of the second Helper. Jesus answered and said to Marayam in the midst of the disciples: "Aman, amen, I say to you: The second Helper is distant from the first Helper in great immeasurable distance in regard to the height above and the depth below and the length and the breadth. For he is exceedingly distant from him in great immeasurable distance through the angels and all the archangels and through the gods and all the invisibles. And he is very considerably greater than the latter in an incalculable measure through the angels and archangels and through the gods and all the invisibles. And he shines more than the latter in an utterly immeasurable measure, there being no measure for the light in which he is, and no measure for him through angels and archangels and through the gods and all the invisibles, as I have already said to you at another time.

Of the third, fourth, and fifth Helpers. "In like manner also the third Helper and fourth and fifth Helper,--one is greater than the other... and shines more than the latter and is distant from him in a great immeasurable distance through the angels and archangels and the gods and all the invisibles, as I have already said to you at another time. And I will tell to you also the type of every one [of them] at their expansion."

Marayam again questions Jesus. It came to pass then, when Jesus had finished saying these words to his disciples, that Marayam Magdalene came forward again, continued and said to Jesus: "My Adanay, in what type will
be those who have received the mystery of the Light, in the midst of the last Helper?"

Of those who receive the mystery in the last Helper. And Jesus answered and said to Marayam in the midst of the disciples: "They who have received the mystery of the Light, if they come out of the body of the matter of the rulers, then will every one be in his order according to the mystery which he has received. Those who have received the higher mysteries, will abide in the higher order; those who have received the lower mysteries will be in the lower orders. In a word, up to what region every one has received mysteries, there will he abide in his order in the Inheritance of the Light. For which cause I have said to you aforetime: 'Where your heart is, there will your treasure be,'--that is up to what region every one has received mysteries, there shall he be."

It came to pass, when Jesus had finished saying these words to his disciples, that Yawachanan came forward and said to Jesus: "My Adanay and my Saviour, give me also commandment that I discourse before you, and be not wroth with me if I question concerning all with precision and certainty; for you, my Adanay, have promised me in an promise to make revelation to us of all concerning which I shall question you. Now, therefore, my Adanay, hide nothing from us at all in the matter on which we shall question you."

And Jesus answered in great compassion and said to Yawachanan: "To you also, blessed Yawachanan, and beloved, I give commandment to speak the word which pleases you, and I will reveal it to you face to face without similitude, and I
will say to you all on which you will question me with precision and certainty."

Yawachanan questions Jesus. And Yawachanan answered and said to Jesus: "My Adanay, will then every one abide in the region up to which he has received the mysteries, and has he no power to go. into other orders which are above him; and has he no power to go into the orders which are below him?"

And Jesus answered and said to Yawachanan: "Finely indeed do you question on all with precision and certainty. But now, therefore, Yawachanan, hearken that I may discourse with you. Every one who has received mysteries of the Light, will abide in the region up to which every one has received mysteries, and he has not the power to go into the height into the orders which are above him.

Of the first Commandment. "So that he who has received mysteries in the first Commandment, has the power to go into the orders which are below him, that is into all the orders of the third [?] space; but he has not the power to go into the height to the orders which are above him.

Of the first space. "And he who shall receive the mysteries of the First Mystery, which is the four-and-twentieth mystery from without and the head of the first space which is without,--he has the power to go into all the orders which are without him; but he has not the power to go into the regions which are above him or to pass through them.

Of the second space. "And of those who have received the mysteries in the orders of the four-and-twenty mysteries, every one will go into the region in which he has received mysteries, and he will have the
power to pass through all the orders and spaces which are without him; but he has not the power to go into the higher orders which are above him or to pass through them.

Of the third space. "And he who has received mysteries in the orders of the First Mystery which is in the third space, has the power to go into all the lower orders which are below him and to pass through all; but on the other hand he has not the power to go into the regions which are above him or to pass through them.

Of the Thrice-spirituals. "And he who has received mysteries of the first Thrice-spiritual, which rules over the four-and-twenty mysteries all together which rule over the space of the First Mystery, of whose region at the expansion of the universe I will tell you--he, therefore, who shall receive the mystery of that Thrice-spiritual, has the power to go down into all orders which are below him; but he has not the power to go into the height into the orders which are above him, that is into all the orders of the space of the Ineffable.

"And he who has received the mystery of the second Thrice-spiritual, has the power to go into all the orders of the first Thrice-spiritual and to pass through them all and all their orders which are in them; but he has not the power to go into the higher orders of the third Thrice-spiritual.

"And he who has received the mystery of the third Thrice-spiritual, which rules over the three Thrice-spirituals and the three spaces of the First Mystery all together, [has the power to go into all the orders which are below him]; but he has not the power to go into the height
